words.gloss: he who does not live accordingly

literal: Knowing the measure, he who does not live, his life, as if existing, becoming non-existent, without appearing, will perish.
translation: The life of one who does not live knowing the measure of his resources will seem to prosper, but will vanish without a trace and perish.
modern: தன் பொருளின் அளவை அறிந்து வாழாதவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை, இருப்பது போலத் தோன்றி, பின் இல்லாமல் போய், சுவடு தெரியாமல் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against living beyond one's means. The word 'அளவு' refers to the limit or measure of one's wealth and resources. If a person does not live ('வாழாதான்') with this awareness, their prosperity ('வாழ்க்கை') might outwardly look abundant and real ('உள போல'). However, this illusion of wealth will quickly turn into nothing ('இல்லாகி') and disappear so completely that even the trace of its former existence will not be seen ('தோன்றாக் கெடும்').
